look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: At the leaf blade/sheath junction check for NO ligule and NO auricles; then inspect the coarse, branched panicle with crowded spikelets and often bristly branch axes. Awn length varies. The selected first image shows the seedhead only; collar/ligule needs a later diagnostic macro.
diagnostic_image_needs: leaf collar close-up confirming absence of ligule and auricles
